sections.theory:
Exercise questions

1. Choose and write the suitable answers.

i. The minimum weight of the netball is ________ grams.

(a) 297  (b) 397  (c) 497  (d) 597

ii. In netball the diameter of the central circle is ________ feet.

(a) 3  (b) 5  (c) 7  (d) 9

iii. In netball the game is started with ________ .

(a) centre pass  (b) centre third  (c) centre forward  (d) goal throw

iv. In the game of netball it is necessary to pass within ________ seconds.

(a) 3  (b) 5  (c) 7  (d) 9

v. The breadth of the netball court is ________ feet.

(a) 40  (b) 50  (c) 60  (d) 70

vi. In the game of netball the number of players is ________ .

(a) 3  (b) 5  (c) 7  (d) 9

vii. The length of the netball court is ________ feet.

(a) 60  (b) 80  (c) 100  (d) 120

viii. The middle part of the netball court is called ________ .

(a) centre third  (b) wing defence  (c) goal third  (d) centre
